name: LayerFilter
description: Two-step, configurable layer filter panel. Step 1 (a separate LayerFilterThemes rail) picks a theme; step 2 shows that theme's filters. Configure each theme's filters here under ids matching the rail's entries. Emits the matched layer set on the event bus. Events — emits: plugin:layerfilter:changed { themeId, selections, matchedLayerUUIDs }; subscribes: plugin:layerfilterthemes:selectedThemeChanged.

components.name: Themes & filters (JSON)
components.description: The panel half of the two-step filter config. Each theme: { id, title, description, catalog?, filters: [...] } — `id` must match an entry in the LayerFilterThemes rail's config, which owns the rail label and icon. Filters default to matching layer.properties[property]; `multi: true` allows several values (`matchAll: true` = contains-all); `from: "catalog"` reads catalogue entry properties, with `derived: "datetimes"` for a Year filter, `isEntry: true` for a pick-one-entry control, and `type: "geocode"` for a place search that keeps entries by geometry intersection (layer themes test the layer's own properties.bbox [west, south, east, north] first). Options and counts are always derived from the data, never enumerated here.
